verdict.rationale: CIPO is a government IP office with online filing services, accounts, databases and bulk data. A portal like this could plausibly offer scheduled saved-search alerts or recurring tasks, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents any way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows: bulk data downloads and online filing are one-off actions, not recurring schedules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
